notes.title: Scrapshoot 1.2 Update Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Another year of absolute Scrap![/h1]
[i]Scrapshoot update 1.2 has landed![/i]

This update is all about adding in brand new features. We've got maps, gamemodes, quality of life changes, and a slew of bugfixes.

[h1]New Map: Nuclear Swamp[/h1]
[i]A brand new map with a unique gamemode[/i]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/673203207832600578/1208286284263465061/scrapshoot_new_map_gif_900px.gif?ex=65e2bb4b&is=65d0464b&hm=ae5155697eb3d1180b9787e91c21724735cbdf7594aefeb3be5990b407aaa474&[/img]

We're happy to have added a brand new map - the Nuclear Swamp! Dodge falling globs of acid, watch the river glow at night, and beat your friends in the fourth map to come to Scrapshoot! Pools of acid slow down you down and damage your bots, be sure to watch out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41301909/7ec66f6b1446bceb466e868cc4a8d5fa8fc0f9b4.png[/img]

[h1]Gamemode Rework: Nighttime[/h1]
We’ve also worked on an overhauled nighttime mode. Race your friends to collect batteries, which will allow you to keep moving quickly around the battlefield without running out of power. This effect has been applied to all nighttime maps, and overlaps with over map specific mechanics such as snow, conveyor belts, and the new acid mechanic.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/673203207832600578/1208286283760275517/scrapshoot_battery_gif_900px.gif?ex=65e2bb4a&is=65d0464a&hm=9d60e0175c6ca9567239d854e1f46e0708f3e4e5307137b0d81828e299f4c45c&[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[i]Finally, there’s always plenty of bugs to be squashed and minor improvements to be made.[/i]

Fixed controller navigation in all menus
Fixed in-game menus which couldn’t be closed with “B” on controllers
Fixed hat menu softlock

[h3]Other tweaks[/h3]
Bot and Disaster info menus improved
Gameplay Settings menu overhaul
Added more intuitive exit buttons to menus
Added 3 new hats to unlock
Adjusted scrap and item spawn rate
Made AI slightly easier to play against
Improved appearance of UI sliders
Replaced Acid Rain icon
Replaced Battery powerup with Tesla Coil

There are other bugs we are aware of and working hard to fix, as well as some exciting content coming down the pipeline… Stay scrappy friends!
[i]
Keep your eyes peeled for some more updates this year, and we hope you enjoy playing Scrapshoot during the Remote Play fest![/i]

notes.title: Scrapshoot February Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41301909/d44b2234d99c1efc0bc8441608413300769a0105.png[/img][h1]Welcome to the Scrapshoot February Patch![/h1]
We've made a number of changes to help out the general look and feel of Scrapshoot- from gameplay, to menus, to festive add-ons! Be on the look out for more comfortable keyboard controls and a new slippery snow level.
We've also worked on a heap of bug fixes and polish updates this month!
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with players moving out of bounds
[*]Resolved bug that would cause the pause menu to lock
[*]Achievement "Quick Draw McGraw" fixed
[/list]
[h2]Other tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added menu select for previous holiday menus
[*]Added snow map with slippery movement to map select
[*]Loading screen
[*]New Hat Unlock animation after each round
[*]Update notes now included on main menu
[*]Updated hat visuals and new Love Day hats
[*]Changed keyboard controls to WASD JK
[*]Updated controls menu to reflect new keyboard controls
[*]Visual fixes to Bot Index
[*]Visual update to controller button icons
[/list]

notes.title: Scrapshoot Winter Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to the Scrapshoot Winter Update![/h1]
We've added wintry elements to the main menu, and you'll find the outdoor map completely snowed in! You can also unlock new holiday-themed hats to play with!
In addition, we've got a slew of bug fixes and polish updates to make Scrapshoot even more fun to play!
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with the Daily Run Achievements
[*]Fixed a bug preventing the AI from using the forcefield lever after the early game
[*]Switched the forcefield off by default in the gamemode preferences
[/list]
[h2]Other tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added credits
[*]All players must now confirm their hat selections before the game starts
[*]Expanded controls screen with both keyboard and controller visuals
[*]Added a section to the How To Play menu with details about the different kinds of bots
[*]Visual fixes to the Factory level
[/list]
